title: Tell Me What I'm Missing
description: Give it a plan, decision or idea. It challenges your assumptions, finds what's missing and points out what you stopped questioning because you already like the idea.
promise: Give it a plan, decision or idea. Its job is not to praise you. Its job is to find the holes.
what_it_does: It challenges your assumptions, identifies missing information, surfaces risks and points out what you may have stopped questioning because you already like the idea.
when_to_use: Right after you've decided something and feel great about it.
Before you take a plan to anyone who can say no.
When everyone you've asked agrees with you.
what_to_give_it: The plan, decision or idea. A few sentences is enough.
What you're hoping the answer is. Be honest.
what_you_get: The three assumptions most likely to make it fail.
The information you don't have yet.
The risks you've been skating past.
What evidence would change the conclusion.
